items.title: Visual Arts Open Lecture Series: Deanna Bowen
items.description: Join us for an afternoon Visual Arts lecture with Deanna Bowen, a Montreal-based interdisciplinary artist whose practice includes films, video installations, performances, drawing, sculpture and photography.

items.title: Visual Arts Open Lecture Series: Tania Willard
items.description: Join us for an afternoon Visual Arts lecture with Tania Willard, a mixed Secwépemc and settler artist whose research intersects with land-based art practices.

items.title: Remembrance Day Parade and Ceremony
items.description: The Banff Legion hosts the Remembrance Day Parade starting at the Legion at 10:30 a.m., marching south on Banff Avenue and to the Banff Elementary School, where there is a memorial service. Following the service, the parade returns to the Legion, where there will be a wreath ceremony.

items.title: Visual Arts Open Lecture Series: Tarah Hogue
items.description: Join Banff Centre for an afternoon Visual Arts lecture with writer and curator Tarah Hogue, based in Treaty 6 and 7 territories and the Métis homeland.

items.title: Mountain Writers Intensive Reading
items.description: Celebrate the power of words shaped by mountains at the Mountain Writers Intensive Reading, a free public event in Banff Centre's intimate CLVB '33. items.title: Reel Time: The Christophers
items.description: Reel Time features some of the best films from the Toronto International Film Festival. Organized by Banff Centre, Reel Time has brought alternative cinema to the Bow Valley for over fifteen years.

items.title: Decolonizing the Narrative Conversation Series with Leelay Gilday
items.description: Join us for a conversation with singer/songwriter Leelay Gilday, Banff Centre alumna, former program faculty, and featured artist. items.title: William Prince | On Rolls The Wheel Tour
items.description: JUNO Award-winning singer-songwriter William Prince brings his On Rolls The Wheel Tour to Banff Centre on November 20 for an intimate acoustic performance.

items.title: Winter Solstice Community Lantern Skate — December 21
items.description: Banff and Bow Valley residents, create your own beautiful lantern! We will all light up our lanterns for an evening skate, where we will enjoy some live local music and stay warm sipping hot tea by the fire.

items.title: Road Closures: Wednesday, November 11 — Remembrance Day Parade
items.description: The Banff Remembrance Day Parade, memorial service and wreath laying ceremony on Tuesday, November 11, will involve road closures on Banff Avenue and Elk Street.

items.title: Remembrance Day Parade and Ceremony — November 11
items.description: The Banff Legion hosts the Remembrance Day Parade on November 11.

items.title: Banff residents can now recycle more
items.description: Plastic bags, styrofoam, candy wrappers, coffee cups among materials that can now be diverted from landfill!

items.title: New drop-in recreation sessions offer more ways to use your Pauw Pass
items.description: From badminton to roller disco, and soccer to pickleball, there is something for everyone in the Town of Banff’s updated drop-in recreation schedule.
